rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing or stating something officially or formally.

example.traditional: 我哋正式咁宣布呢個決定。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zing3 sik1 gam2 syun1 bou3 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this specifically when “officially” means according to official rules or regulations.

example.english: Officially, applicants have to bring all the documents according to the official regulations.
example.traditional: 按官方規定，申請人要帶齊文件。
example.jyutping: on3 gun1 fong1 kwai1 ding6 san1 cing2 jan4 jiu3 daai3 cai4 man4 gin6
